subject: CSC scholarship inquiry: Advanced Database Systems and Queries at Peking University
body:
Dear Professor Bin Cui,

I am writing to you at Peking University, 北京大学计算机学院. I am interested in applying for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC), and I would like to ask whether you would be willing to supervise or support my application if a proposed project aligns with your group's work.

I am completing a BS Software Engineering at Jinnah University for Women (JUW), with expected graduation in 2026. The overlap I can describe from your stored evidence is Advanced Database Systems and Queries and Data Management and Algorithms. My software engineering coursework includes databases and data handling, which is the part of this work I can speak about directly.

My final-year project, MedScribeAI, is relevant here only as software that stores structured records from speech and clinical text. It uses Python, FastAPI, React Native, TypeScript, and a database. I am not presenting it as medical research or as a claim that I am an artificial-intelligence researcher.

I can send my curriculum vitae and transcripts if that would be useful.

Sincerely,
